model_output:
```sql
WITH largest_park AS (
  SELECT 
    park_name,
    geometry
  FROM 
    parks
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(geometry::geometry, ST_GeomFromText('[2].geo_wkt_omitted', 4326)::geometry)
    AND park_name ILIKE '%Orange County%'
    AND park_name ILIKE '%Florida%'
  ORDER BY 
    ST_Area(geometry::geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
park_raster_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      1,
      (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM largest_park),
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM largest_park))
),
max_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX((val).val) AS max_elevation
  FROM 
    (SELECT ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_rast, 1) AS val FROM park_raster_clip) v
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT park_name FROM largest_park) AS park_name,
  max_elevation
FROM 
  max_elevation;
```
